intro: Mobile paintless dent repair in Jacksonville, by owner Mike Parks. He removes minor dents and keeps your original paint, without a body shop visit.

mobile.title: Door dings, at your door.
mobile.intro: For door dings and small dents, I come to you. Hail, deer hits and larger dents are repaired at my Jacksonville shop.

points.name: At your location
points.text: Mike comes to you. Mobile service only, by appointment.

points.name: No shop visit
points.text: No body shop drop-off and no waiting around for your car.

points.name: Straight to the owner
points.text: From the first call to the finished repair, you deal with Mike Parks.

points.name: Easy to start
points.text: Call (904) 347-1065 and text photos of the damage.

servicesIntro: From a single door ding to a full hail storm. No job too big or too small.

services.name: Paintless dent repair
services.text: Minor dents removed while your vehicle's original paint stays in place.

services.name: Fender repair
services.text: Dents worked out of fenders on trucks and SUVs, like a Lincoln Aviator or a pickup.

services.name: Door repair
services.text: Dents and dings removed from doors, including a Land Rover door.

services.name: Trunk and liftgate repair
services.text: Careful repair that follows every contour of the panel.

why.name: Since 1995
why.text: Mike founded Smooth A Dent in 1995 and has done tens of thousands of repairs.

why.name: Owner-operated
why.text: You work directly with Mike Parks from first conversation to finished repair.

why.name: An honest assessment
why.text: Each dent is evaluated first, so you know what is possible and the price before work begins.

howTitle: Back to like new, step by step.

steps.name: Send the details
steps.text: Call, or use the form with your year, make, model and photos of the damage.

steps.name: Get an evaluation
steps.text: Bring the vehicle in and we look at the hail damage, dings or film options.

steps.name: Drive it smooth
steps.text: We work the dents out and hand the vehicle back.
